Commentary: New Zealand Squad: Will Young, Tim Seifert, Henry Nicholls, Daryl Mitchell, Tom Latham(w), Glenn Phillips, Mitchell Santner(c), Nathan Smith, Kyle Jamieson, Jacob Duffy, Blair Tickner, Nick Kelly, Matthew Fisher, Michael Bracewell, Matt Henry

India Squad: Rohit Sharma, Shubman Gill(c), Virat Kohli, Shreyas Iyer, Axar Patel, KL Rahul(w), Naman Dhir, Anshul Kamboj, Auqib Nabi, Gurnoor Brar, Arshdeep Singh, Ruturaj Gaikwad, Mohammed Siraj, Ishan Kishan, Kuldeep Yadav
Squads:
Will Young and Tim Seifert are at the crease. Will Young is on strike. Arshdeep Singh will open the attack
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, on a good length and shaping back into the right-hander - Young prods across and defends it to the on-side

Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, nicely bowled, Arshdeep shortens the length and gets it to nip away with the seam, some extra bounce and he nearly made Young spar at that, withdraws the bat at the last moment and lets it go
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, the nip-backer from Arshdeep, comes back into the right-hander and Young plays late, closes the face of the bat and drops it down at his feet
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, short of a good length and a hint of shape back into the right-hander - Young plays late and defends it to the off-side

Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, beautifully bowled, pitched up and shaping away from the right-hander - brings Young forward and the movement takes it past the outside edge. Young wasn't fully committed, played inside the line and was happy to leave
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, no run, on a good length and a hint of shape back into the right-hander - Young prods across and defends it to mid-on. Arshdeep starts with a maiden over
Auqib Nabi to share the new ball
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, no run, fuller length delivery outside off - Tim Seifert leans forward and push-drives it to mid-off
Two slips in place
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, no run, short of a good length and holding its line outside off, left alone
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, no run, on a good length and in that channel just outside off - Seifert presses forward tentatively and gets an inside edge onto his pad
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, no run, tad fuller and just outside off - a half-forward stride from Seifert as he defended it to the off-side
Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Auqib Nabi to Tim Seifert, out Caught by Anshul Kamboj!! Caught at mid-on, maiden ODI wicket for Auqib Nabi - Simon Doull did talk about the two-paced nature of the pitch during the pitch report, he did say that the odd ball could stop onto the batters and that could bring the mistimed drives into play and that's exactly what's happened here. Pitched up on off and Seifert was a fraction early into the drive, chips it in the air and Kamboj completes a fine catch, diving forward at mid-on. Just the start India wanted after having won a good toss. Tim Seifert c Anshul Kamboj b Auqib Nabi 0(5)
Henry Nicholls, left handed bat, comes to the crease

Auqib Nabi to Nicholls, 2 runs, fuller length delivery and swinging into the left-hander, but it's too straight from Nabi and it's flicked past square leg for a couple. Nicholls and New Zealand off and running here in Wellington
Arshdeep Singh to Will Young, 1 run, length ball at the pads, clipped behind square on the on-side for a single
Arshdeep Singh to Nicholls, no run, on a good length and around the off-stump channel, defended off the back-foot to the on-side
